en.headline: Three injured after seven-seater hits barrier and overturns in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: The dual-plate vehicle struck a central divider on Wan Po Road near the sports ground around 5 a.m., skidded more than 50 metres and flipped; one passenger was taken to hospital.
body: A seven-seater vehicle with dual Hong Kong–mainland plates overturned on Wan Po Road in Tseung Kwan O early Sunday after striking a central barrier. Police received the report at about 5 a.m. The vehicle was travelling towards the industrial estate when it hit the sloping divider near the sports ground, continued for more than 50 metres and flipped onto its side.

Firefighters freed three people who were trapped inside. The 38-year-old male driver and a 32-year-old male passenger sustained minor injuries and assisted police at the scene. A 30-year-old female passenger complained of headache and discomfort and was taken conscious to Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

Preliminary information suggested the driver may have misjudged the road layout at the point where the carriageway splits between a flyover and the ground-level route. Parts were scattered across the road and plastic bollards were damaged. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 將軍澳七人車撞壆衝前翻側 三人輕傷一人送院
zh.dek: 中港牌七人車清晨在環保大道撞向分隔石壆後失控翻側，三人一度被困，女乘客送院治理。
body: 一輛掛有中港兩地車牌的七人車周日清晨在將軍澳環保大道發生車禍。約清晨5時，車輛沿往工業邨方向行駛，途經運動場對開撞向路中斜台式分隔石壆，失控衝前逾50米後向左翻側。
消防到場救出被困的三名乘客。38歲男司機及32歲男乘客輕傷，在場協助調查；30歲女乘客報稱頭痛及身體不適，清醒由救護車送往將軍澳醫院治理。
初步消息指司機可能在道路分流處猶豫，報稱「扭多」肇禍。現場有零件散落及膠柱被毀。警方正調查意外原因。
